categories.name: Stand-On Mowers

categories.name: Gas Tools

models.name: Renegade Diesel
models.tagline: Diesel-powered flagship commercial zero-turn
models.summary: The Renegade Diesel is the top of Bad Boy's zero-turn range, pairing a liquid-cooled Perkins three-cylinder diesel with a 61-inch fabricated deck. It shares the Renegade's dual-pump belt system and 3-link rear suspension, and is aimed at professional crews and owners of large properties.
highlights: 61" sloped fabricated deck in 1/4" (3-gauge) steel with 3/8" reinforced sides
Patented 3-link rear trailing arm suspension plus independent front suspension
Dual 16cc Hydro-Gear pumps with 18ci Parker wheel motors
13-gallon diesel capacity from dual feed tanks
Key fob start with digital diagnostic display

models.name: Renegade Gas
models.tagline: Top-tier commercial zero-turn with EFI gas power
models.summary: The gas Renegade carries the same heavy fabricated deck and suspension package as the diesel model but runs on a Rehlko EFI V-twin. It comes in 61- and 72-inch widths and adds conveniences like key fob start and a built-in striping kit.
highlights: Dual-pump belt system with tensioner design
3-link rear trailing arm suspension and cast I-beam independent front suspension
Key fob start and digital diagnostics display

models.summary: The Rogue is a commercial zero-turn offered in 54-, 61- and 72-inch widths with Kawasaki, Rehlko or Vanguard power. It uses Bad Boy's EZ-Ride GEN 2 3-link rear suspension with independent front suspension and a heavy fabricated deck.
highlights: Kawasaki, Rehlko and Vanguard engine options from 35 to 40 hp
EZ-Ride GEN 2 3-link rear suspension with independent front suspension
Dual 16cc Hydro-Gear pumps with 18ci Parker wheel motors
Adjustable suspension seat, striping kit and run-flat tires standard

models.tagline: Faster Rebel with 5400 transaxles and no-flat tires
models.summary: The Rebel X builds on the Rebel with heavier Hydro-Gear 5400 integrated transaxles for more speed and VPO ReaPro no-flat rear tires. It comes with 61- or 72-inch Armor-Tek decks and Kawasaki or Vanguard EFI engines up to 40 hp.
highlights: Dual Hydro-Gear 5400 series integrated drive systems
Kawasaki FX1000V EFI or Vanguard EFI engines (38.5-40 hp)
VPO ReaPro no-flat rear turf tires
Premium adjustable suspension seat, adjustable steering arms and pedals
Striping kit and deck step included

Kawasaki engine lineup from 27 to 38.5 hp, including EFI options

models.tagline: Streamlined Rebel for homeowners wanting real power
models.summary: The Rebel SD is built on the Rebel platform but simplified for homeowners, using a single 25 hp Rehlko Confidant engine. It keeps the 1/4-inch fabricated deck, Hydro-Gear 4400 drives and 13-gallon tank in 54- and 61-inch widths.
highlights: Dual Hydro-Gear 4400 series integrated drive systems
Electric PTO with foot-assist deck lift
High-back comfort seat with adjustable handles and pedals

models.tagline: Entry-level commercial zero-turn, 42" to 60"
models.summary: The Maverick HD is Bad Boy's entry-level professional mower, upgrading the Maverick with Hydro-Gear ZT-3400 drives and pro-class spindles. Its range of deck sizes, from a gate-friendly 42 inches to 60 inches, suits both tight properties and larger lawns.
highlights: Dual Hydro-Gear ZT-3400 commercial-grade integrated drives
Patented EZ-Ride rear suspension with independent front I-beam rails
Premium adjustable suspension seat and adjustable steering arms

models.summary: The MZ Magnum is a residential zero-turn built alongside Bad Boy's commercial mowers, featuring a sloped 7-gauge welded deck instead of a stamped one. It uses Hydro-Gear EZT-2200 drives and is offered with Kawasaki, Rehlko or Briggs engines.

models.tagline: Bad Boy's smallest zero-turn, a 42" gate-fitter
models.summary: The MZ Rambler is Bad Boy's most compact gas zero-turn, sized for smaller lawns with a 42-inch sloped welded deck that fits through gates. It shares its steel frame with the ZT Elite and MZ Magnum and offers Briggs, Rehlko or Kawasaki power.

Three engine options from 19 to 22 hp

models.tagline: Battery-electric zero-turn on the 80V E-Series platform
models.summary: The E-Magnum is Bad Boy's first electric zero-turn, running quiet brushless motors on the same 80V batteries used across the E-Series tool line. It keeps a fabricated 42-inch steel deck and adds LED headlights, a digital display and on-board charging.
highlights: Brushless electric drive powered by 80V E-Series batteries
On- and off-board 120V charging, about 90-minute charge time
LED headlights, digital display and USB charging port
Batteries interchangeable with other 80V E-Series tools

models.name: Raider
models.tagline: Commercial walk-behind with optional EZ-Ride sulky
models.summary: The Raider is a walk-behind commercial mower with a Kawasaki engine and 36-, 48- or 54-inch welded decks. All main controls sit on one control bar, and a central lock holds both transmissions for straight cuts; an optional patented sulky adds a ride-on option.
highlights: Single-lever deck lift and adjustable two-position podium
Central lock engages both transmissions for straight cuts
Brake, PTO and drive levers grouped on the control bar

models.name: Revolt X
models.tagline: Top stand-on mower with pump-and-motor drive
models.summary: The Revolt X is Bad Boy's premium stand-on mower, using independent Hydro-Gear pumps and wheel motors and engines up to 40 hp. A short frame, curved I-beam front rail and suspended operator platform aim for agility and a smooth ride on 54- to 72-inch decks.
highlights: Dual Hydro-Gear 16cc pumps with 18ci wheel motors
Kawasaki EFI or Vanguard EFI engines, 31-40 hp
Adjustable suspended riding platform with upgraded operator pad
Three-position speed control and R-Series style brake

models.name: Revolt
models.tagline: Compact commercial stand-on from 36" to 61"
models.summary: The Revolt is a commercial stand-on mower with integrated Hydro-Gear drives and a short frame for visibility and maneuverability. It comes in four deck widths with Kawasaki or Vanguard engines and features a suspended platform and hand-operated height-of-cut control.
highlights: Kawasaki and Vanguard engines from 22 to 31 hp
Curved I-beam front rail with 3/8" steel forks
Adjustable rubber suspension riding platform and thigh pad
Three-position speed control, electric PTO and striping kit

models.tagline: Residential-size stand-on in 34" and 42" widths
models.summary: The Revolt SD adapts the Revolt stand-on for homeowners and smaller properties, with gate-friendly 34- and 42-inch decks. It uses Hydro-Gear 2800 drives, a patented suspension platform and a quick-remove operator pad.
highlights: Quick-remove operator pad for service access
Three-position speed control and electric PTO

models.name: Revolt Fury Stand-On Blower
models.tagline: 7,500 CFM stand-on blower for commercial cleanup
models.summary: The Revolt Fury is a dedicated stand-on debris blower built on the Revolt X platform. A 40 hp Vanguard EFI engine drives a 7,500 CFM blower with a chute that rotates 180 degrees and tilts 11 degrees, for clearing leaves and clippings on large properties.
highlights: 7,500 CFM blower driven by a 40 hp Vanguard EFI engine
180° horizontal and 11° vertical chute adjustment with hand controls
Built on the Revolt X stand-on platform with independent front suspension
Dual Hydro-Gear 16cc pumps and 18ci wheel motors, up to 12 mph
Standard LED work lights and 13-gallon fuel tank

specs.label: Drive System
specs.value: Dual Hydro-Gear independent 16cc pumps; dual Hydro-Gear independent 18ci wheel motors

models.name: Push Mower
models.tagline: Commercial-grade self-propelled gas push mower
models.summary: Bad Boy's gas push mower is a self-propelled, commercial-grade walk mower with a 14-gauge steel deck in 21- or 25-inch widths. A Kawasaki engine and a patented two-speed transmission power the rear wheels, and it can bag or mulch.
highlights: 21" or 25" all-steel 14-gauge deck with reinforced edges

models.name: E-Series Self-Propelled Mower
models.tagline: 80V battery self-propelled 21" mower
models.summary: The E-Series Self-Propelled Mower is an 80V battery walk mower with a brushless motor and a 21-inch steel deck. Smart Cut technology adjusts blade speed in thick or wet grass, and it can bag, mulch or side-discharge.
highlights: 80V brushless motor with Smart Cut (2800-3200 RPM)
21" steel deck with 3-in-1 bag, mulch and side discharge
Dual battery ports with automatic switching
Uses the cross-platform E-Series battery system

models.name: 5055 Compact Utility Tractor
models.tagline: Bad Boy's most powerful compact utility tractor
models.summary: The 5055 is the largest tractor in Bad Boy's lineup, with a 55 hp four-cylinder diesel and a 2,700 lb loader lift capacity. It is offered as an open station or with a climate-controlled cab, with either a synchro shuttle-shift or hydrostatic transmission.
highlights: 2,700 lb loader lift capacity at the pins (BBL500 loader)
Synchro shuttle-shift (16F/16R) or Hydro Max HST transmission
Optional climate-controlled cab with heated leather seat
Selectable 4WD, differential lock, power steering and cruise control

models.tagline: 35 hp compact tractor with optional factory cab
models.summary: The 4035 is a 35 hp compact tractor with a three-cylinder diesel, Hydro Max three-range hydrostatic transmission and 2,200 lb loader lift capacity. It is available as an open-station 4035H or as the 4035CH with a heated and air-conditioned factory cab.
highlights: 2,200 lb loader lift capacity at the pins (BBL400 loader)
Hydro Max three-range HST with dual pedals and cruise control
Factory cab with heat and air available
Metal hood and fenders, cast iron axles

models.tagline: 25 hp compact workhorse on a full-size frame
models.summary: The 4025 pairs a 25 hp diesel with the same large compact frame and BBL400 loader used on the 4035, giving it a 2,200 lb loader lift capacity. A three-range Hydro Max hydrostatic transmission, independent PTO and selectable 4WD come standard.
highlights: 2,200 lb loader lift capacity at the pins (BBL400 loader)
Hydro Max three-range HST with dual pedals
Independent PTO and selectable 4WD with differential lock
Metal hood and fenders, cast iron axles

models.name: 3026 Compact Tractor
models.tagline: Bridges compact and sub-compact with high clearance
models.summary: The 3026 sits between Bad Boy's sub-compact and compact tractors, combining a 25 hp diesel with a longer frame, larger tires and 16.4 inches of ground clearance. It has a three-range Hydro Max transmission, a reverse-mount engine and a 1,314 lb loader lift capacity.
highlights: 1,314 lb loader lift capacity at the pins (BBL300 loader)
Hydro Max three-range HST with dual pedals
Digital control display and power steering

models.name: 1025 Sub-Compact Tractor
models.tagline: 25 hp sub-compact with optional mid-mount deck
models.summary: The 1025 is a sub-compact tractor with a roughly 25 hp diesel, a two-range Hydro Max transmission and a 992 lb loader lift capacity. It is small enough for barn stalls and gates and accepts an optional drive-over mid-mount mower deck.
highlights: 992 lb loader lift capacity at the pins (BBL105 loader)
Hydro Max two-range HST with dual pedals
Independent PTO, power steering and selectable 4WD

specs.label: Loader Lift Capacity
specs.value: 992 lbs. to full height at pivot pin (BBL105)

models.name: 1022 Sub-Compact Tractor
models.tagline: Entry sub-compact tractor for small properties
models.summary: The 1022 is the entry point to Bad Boy's tractor lineup, using a 21.5 hp Tier 4 diesel, a two-range Hydro Max transmission with treadle pedals and a 617 lb loader lift capacity. An optional 54-inch drive-over mid-mount deck turns it into a mower as well.
highlights: 617 lb loader lift capacity at the pins (BBL100 loader)
Hydro Max two-range HST with treadle-style pedals
Independent PTO, power steering and selectable 4WD

specs.label: Loader Lift Capacity
specs.value: 617 lbs. to full height at pivot pin (BBL100)

models.name: Rotary Cutters
models.tagline: Standard- and heavy-duty brush cutters, 4' to 10'
models.summary: Bad Boy's 3-point rotary cutters come in standard-duty and heavy-duty versions for clearing brush and pasture. Decks are 10-gauge on heavy-duty models (11-gauge on standard-duty), with adjustable tail wheels and a stump-jumper gearbox mount.
highlights: Slip clutch or shear pin driveline protection

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: Heavy-duty: 2 years; standard-duty: 1 year; 5-year limited on gearboxes

models.name: Flex Wing Cutter
models.tagline: 12-foot pull-type flex wing cutter
models.summary: The flex wing cutter is a 12-foot pull-type mower for covering large open areas quickly. It uses a 10-gauge deck and a slip clutch with a CV U-joint driveline.

models.name: Box Blades
models.tagline: Box blades for grading and leveling, 4' to 7'
models.summary: Box blades handle grading, leveling and spreading material behind the tractor. They have adjustable shanks, two blades for scalping or cutting, and a square-tube main frame.
highlights: Adjustable shanks (4 to 7 depending on width)
CAT 1 or quick hitch (7' also CAT 2)

models.name: Land Graders
models.tagline: Land graders for driveways and site prep, 5' to 7'
models.summary: Land graders shape and smooth driveways, gravel and dirt. They feature fully adjustable blades, replaceable skids and adjustable shanks.
highlights: Fully adjustable blades and replaceable skids
CAT 1 or quick hitch (7' also CAT 2)

models.name: Rotary Tillers
models.tagline: Gear-driven PTO tillers, 4' to 7'
models.summary: Rotary tillers break and prepare soil for planting using a gearbox-driven 540 RPM PTO. They offer forward or reverse till options, adjustable skids and slip-clutch protection.
highlights: Slip clutch driveline protection; quick hitch compatible

models.name: Disc Harrow
models.tagline: Disc harrows for breaking ground, 4' to 7'
models.summary: Disc harrows cut and break up soil and residue ahead of planting. Gang angles are adjustable, and the frames are built from carbon steel tube.
highlights: Adjustable front and rear gang angles
Carbon steel tube main frame and gang tubes

models.name: Forks & Hitches
models.tagline: Hay spears, pallet forks and trailer movers
models.summary: This group covers hay spears, pallet forks and 3-point trailer movers for handling bales, pallets and trailers. Loader-mounted items use quick attach, while the 3-point items fit a CAT 1 hitch.
highlights: Quick-attach front hay spear rated at 1,800 lbs.
3-point hay forks and a hay fork/trailer mover combo
Heavy-duty pallet forks, Class 2, 3,500 lb capacity
Standard pallet forks, Class 2, 2,200 lb capacity

models.name: Front Grapples
models.tagline: Quick-attach loader grapples, large and small
models.summary: Front grapples attach to the loader to grab brush, logs and debris. They come with a hose kit and mount via quick attach.
highlights: Available in 70" large and 48" small sizes

models.name: Grader Blades
models.tagline: Rear blades with 5 forward and 5 reverse positions
models.summary: Grader blades are rear-mounted blades for moving snow, gravel and dirt. Every size offers five forward and five reverse blade positions.
highlights: Heavy-gauge welded and fabricated steel construction

models.name: Landscape Rakes
models.tagline: Landscape rakes for debris and soil prep, 4' to 7'
models.summary: Landscape rakes collect rocks and debris and prepare seedbeds. They have adjustable blade positions and individually mounted tines.

models.name: Mid-Mount Mower Deck
models.tagline: Drive-over decks for the 1022 and 1025H
models.summary: Bad Boy offers drive-over mid-mount mower decks for its 1022 and 1025H sub-compact tractors, built with the same approach as its zero-turn mower decks. They are gearbox-over-belt driven and protected by a shear pin.
highlights: 60" deck for the 1025H, 54" deck for the 1022
Gearbox-over-belt drive with shear pin protection

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 24 months on deck / 12 months on gearbox

models.name: Spreaders
models.tagline: Pull-behind and 3-point spreaders, 600 lb hopper
models.summary: Spreaders broadcast seed, fertilizer and similar materials. Bad Boy offers a ground-driven pull-behind model and a PTO-driven 3-point model, both with galvanized 600 lb hoppers and stainless steel fins.

models.name: Snow Pusher
models.tagline: Loader-mounted snow pusher, 5' to 7'
models.summary: The snow pusher mounts to the loader for clearing heavy snow from drives and lots. It has a 27-inch 7-gauge moldboard with 3/8-inch sidewalls and a choice of steel or UHMW edges and skids.
highlights: Steel or UHMW cutting edge and skids

models.name: Finish Mower
models.tagline: Rear-discharge 3-point finish mower, 5' to 7'
models.summary: The finish mower gives a clean, even cut on large lawns, pastures and fields. It has a 1/4-inch deck, rear discharge and single-pin height adjustment, and is made in the USA.
highlights: Quick-set single-pin height adjustment; quick hitch compatible

models.name: Bandit 550
models.tagline: Two-seat side-by-side with 545cc engine
models.summary: The Bandit 550 is the smaller-engine version of Bad Boy's regular-cab side-by-side, using a 545cc EFI single and suited to recreation and property chores. It shares the Bandit chassis with independent suspension, 4WD, a dump bed and an included winch.
highlights: Electronic fuel injection, liquid cooling and automatic CVT
Four-wheel independent suspension with nitrogen-assisted shocks
Gas-assist cargo dump bed rated at 500 lbs.
Front bumper and 3,500 lb winch included

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: 2WD / 4WD selectable, front locking differential, shaft final drive

specs.label: Suspension
specs.value: Dual A-arm front and rear, hydraulic shocks with nitrogen assist

models.name: Bandit 750
models.tagline: Regular-cab side-by-side with 735cc work engine
models.summary: The Bandit 750 carries the same regular-cab chassis as the 550 but steps up to a 735cc EFI single for heavier work. Standard equipment includes 4WD with a locking differential, a dump bed, a front bumper and a winch.
highlights: Electronic fuel injection, liquid cooling and automatic CVT
Four-wheel independent suspension with nitrogen-assisted shocks
Gas-assist cargo dump bed rated at 500 lbs.
Front bumper and 3,500 lb winch included

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: 2WD / 4WD selectable, front locking differential, shaft final drive

specs.label: Suspension
specs.value: Dual A-arm front and rear, hydraulic shocks with nitrogen assist

models.name: Bandit 750 Crew Cab
models.tagline: Four-seat Bandit with two rows and 735cc power
models.summary: The Bandit 750 Crew Cab is Bad Boy's first four-seat UTV, adding a second seating row to the 750 platform while keeping the full cargo bed. It has a longer wheelbase and a higher 1,500 lb tow rating than the regular-cab model.
highlights: Two seating rows for four occupants
735cc single-cylinder EFI engine with automatic CVT
Front bumper and 3,500 lb winch included

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: 2WD / 4WD selectable, front locking differential, shaft final drive

specs.label: Suspension
specs.value: Dual A-arm front and rear, hydraulic shocks with nitrogen assist

models.name: Recon
models.tagline: Tracked stand-on mini skid steer, 43" wide
models.summary: The Recon is a stand-on mini skid steer powered by a 25 hp Kubota diesel and running on wide all-terrain tracks. At 43 inches wide it fits tight job sites, and its FlexFlow tandem-pump hydraulics boost pressure for demanding attachments.
highlights: High lift reach of 81.8" for loading trucks and trailers
Ergonomic standing platform with cushioned leaning pad

specs.label: Drive System
specs.value: Dual wheel motors, dual all-terrain wide tracks

models.name: Terrain
models.tagline: Small articulating loader with 40 hp Vanguard EFI
models.summary: The Terrain is a small articulating loader that uses articulated steering to limit turf damage while offering visibility to the bucket edge. A 40 hp Vanguard EFI engine and 19 GPM auxiliary hydraulics run a range of quick-attach implements, and an enclosed cab is available on the premium model.
highlights: Articulated steering for smooth turns and less ground disturbance
Universal quick attach with 60" material bucket standard
Premium suspension seat; enclosed cab with heat and air on premium model

configurations.name: Terrain Premium (hydraulic quick attach lock, rear remote coupler, electric diff lock, enclosed cab with heat and air)

models.name: E-Series String Trimmer
models.tagline: 80V brushless trimmer that accepts attachments
models.summary: The E-Series String Trimmer is an 80V brushless trimmer with a 16-inch cutting path, two speeds and an easy-wind head. Its aluminum shaft accepts Bad Boy's attachment heads, and its battery works across the E-Series line.
highlights: Lightweight aluminum shaft with adjustable handle

models.name: E-Series String Trimmer Attachments
models.tagline: Blower, edger, pruner and hedge clipper heads
models.summary: These sold-separately attachments let the E-Series String Trimmer power head run a blower, edger, pruner or hedge clipper. They connect through a universal coupling and run on the same 80V battery system.
highlights: Blower attachment: up to 470 CFM and over 100 mph
Edger attachment: 9" metal blade, 0.6"-2.2" cutting depth
Pruner attachment: 10" bar and chain, cuts branches up to 6" thick
Hedge clipper attachment with rotating head

models.name: E-Series Backpack Blower
models.tagline: 80V dual-battery backpack blower, 165 mph
models.summary: The E-Series Backpack Blower is an 80V brushless blower with an axial jet fan, variable speed and cruise control. It carries two batteries with automatic switching and offers a turbo mode rated at 690 CFM.
highlights: Brushless motor with axial jet fan
Dual battery ports with auto switch

models.name: E-Series Handheld Blower
models.tagline: Lightweight 80V handheld blower, 170 mph
models.summary: The E-Series Handheld Blower is a lightweight 80V brushless blower using jet fan technology. It provides variable speed with cruise control and a turbo button.
highlights: Brushless motor with axial jet fan

models.name: E-Series Chainsaw
models.tagline: 80V 18" chainsaw rated like a 42cc gas saw
models.summary: The E-Series Chainsaw is an 18-inch 80V brushless saw that Bad Boy rates as comparable to a 42cc gas chainsaw. It includes steel bucking spikes, a mechanical chain brake and an automatic oiler with fill indicator.
highlights: Brushless motor rated comparable to a 42cc gas saw
Steel bucking spikes and wrap-around handle

models.name: E-Series Pole Saw
models.tagline: 80V 10" pole saw reaching up to 11 feet
models.summary: The E-Series Pole Saw puts a 10-inch bar and chain on an 8-foot three-piece aluminum shaft, with an extension for up to 11 feet of reach. It runs on an 80V brushless motor with an automatic oiler.

models.name: E-Series Hedge Trimmer
models.tagline: 80V hedge trimmer with 24" dual-action blades
models.summary: The E-Series Hedge Trimmer uses 24-inch dual-action blades driven by an 80V brushless motor. A rotating rear handle makes it easier to trim at different angles, with up to an hour of run time.

models.name: E-Series Snow Thrower
models.tagline: 80V 22" snow thrower with 180° chute
models.summary: The E-Series Snow Thrower is an 80V brushless unit with a 22-inch clearing width and 13-inch clearing depth. Bad Boy rates it to clear up to a six-car driveway on one charge.
highlights: Clears up to a 6-car driveway per charge

specs.label: Run Time
specs.value: Up to a 6-car driveway per charge

models.name: Corded Electric Pressure Washer
models.tagline: Corded 3,000 CU electric pressure washer
models.summary: This corded electric pressure washer delivers 2,500-3,000 PSI through a AAA triplex brass pump on a welded steel frame. It ships with a turbo nozzle, soap injector, steel lance and high-pressure quick-connect hose.
highlights: AAA triplex brass pump with adjustable external unloader
Heavy-gauge welded steel frame and 3-ply pneumatic tires
Commercial-style soap injector and 16" steel lance

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: Motor 2 yr; pump 5 yr; frame 10 yr

models.name: Gas Pressure Washers
models.tagline: 3,500 and 3,600 PSI gas pressure washers
models.summary: Bad Boy's gas pressure washers come in two models: the BBPW3525 with a CRX210 engine and AAA axial pump, and the BBPW3625 with a Honda GX200 and AAA triplex pump. Both deliver 2.5 GPM on a welded steel frame with pneumatic tires.
highlights: BBPW3525: 3,500 PSI, CRX210 engine, AAA AX300 axial pump
BBPW3625: 3,600 PSI, Honda GX200 engine, AAA CY triplex pump
Turbo nozzle and professional-style trigger gun
Heavy-gauge welded steel frame and 3-ply pneumatic tires

specs.label: Pump
specs.value: BBPW3525: AAA AX300 axial | BBPW3625: AAA CY triplex

models.name: Gas Chainsaw
models.tagline: 30.1cc gas chainsaw with 14" bar
models.summary: The gas chainsaw is a 30.1cc two-stroke saw with a 14-inch bar, built for quick acceleration and clean cuts. It includes an inertia-activated chain brake, full anti-vibration and the PRE-VENT air cleaning system.
highlights: Inertia-activated chain brake and reduced kickback system
PRE-VENT system keeps debris out of the carburetor

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 2 years residential, 1 year commercial, 90 days leasing

models.name: Gas Backpack Blowers
models.tagline: Commercial gas backpack blowers, up to 1,068 CFM
models.summary: Bad Boy offers two gas backpack blowers: the 60.9cc BB880 and the larger 79.2cc BB1060. Both use low-emission two-stroke engines, a spring-loaded anti-vibration frame and padded straps.
highlights: Anti-vibration frame with wide padded straps
BB1060 adds a commercial 2-stage filtration system

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 2 years residential, 1 year commercial, 90 days leasing

models.name: Gas Handheld Blower
models.tagline: 30.1cc handheld blower with cruise control
models.summary: The gas handheld blower is a 30.1cc unit rated at 180 mph with variable speed and cruise control. It is designed to stay light and relatively quiet for long days of cleanup.

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 2 years residential, 1 year commercial, 90 days leasing

models.name: Gas Edger
models.tagline: 25.4cc stick edger with tool-free blade height
models.summary: The gas edger is a 25.4cc commercial-grade stick edger with tool-free blade height adjustment and adjustable throttle control. It has a heavy-duty gliding plate, anti-vibration grip and a steel driveshaft with a lifetime warranty.
highlights: High-visibility shield and heavy-duty gliding plate

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 2 years residential, 1 year commercial, 90 days leasing; steel driveshaft lifetime warranty

models.name: Gas Hedge Trimmer
models.tagline: 22.5cc trimmer with 24" double-reciprocating blades
models.summary: The gas hedge trimmer pairs a 22.5cc engine with 24-inch double-reciprocating chrome steel blades. A forward-facing exhaust keeps hot exhaust off shrubs, and the gearbox uses ball and roller bearings.

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 2 years residential, 1 year commercial, 90 days leasing

models.name: Gas String Trimmers
models.tagline: Three gas string trimmers from 22.5cc to 30.1cc
models.summary: Bad Boy's gas string trimmer line includes the 22.5cc ST225, the 25.4cc ST254 and the 30.1cc ST300T Turbo, which adds torque for wet grass and thick brush. All feature adjustable throttle, anti-vibration grips and a lifetime-warranty steel driveshaft.
highlights: Adjustable throttle control and anti-vibration grip
Steel driveshaft lifetime warranty; waterproof kill switch

specs.label: Weight
specs.value: ST225: 10.5 lbs. | ST254: 11.7 lbs. | ST300T Turbo: 12.2 lbs. (approx.)

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 2 years residential, 1 year commercial, 90 days leasing; steel driveshaft lifetime warranty

notes: Source pages were retrieved directly from badboycountry.com on 2026-10-25 (all 48 URLs returned HTTP 200); specs were transcribed from each page's spec table. No images were fetched.

Category count: the brief lists 11 category slugs but only 10 distinct slugs appear in it (zero-turn, walk-behind, stand-on, push, tractors, implements, utvs, light-construction, e-series-tools, gas-tools); 10 categories were output.

Warranty: mower pages (except the Revolt Fury blower, '2 Years, Unlimited Hours') do not state a warranty, so Warranty is omitted for those mowers. Tractor warranties are powertrain-only as stated (6-yr: 5055/5045/4035/4025/3026; 7-yr: 1025/1022).
Horsepower ranges for multi-engine mowers list the per-engine hp values stated on the page; see configurations for the exact deck/engine pairings.
Maverick page header lists Kawasaki, Rehlko & Vanguard engines but its prose mentions only Rehlko and Kawasaki; ZT Elite prose says '2 engines' while 3 are listed. Spec tables were used.

Renegade Gas page labels its tire row 'Front Tires/Rear Tires' but lists 26x12-12 Reaper first; it was recorded as 26x12-12 rear / 15x6-6 front, matching every other model and the Renegade Diesel page.

5055 and 5045 pages list four variants (S/CS synchro and H/CH HST), not only S/CS; all four are listed as configurations. Their PTO row reads '540, 540E' followed by '584, 791' with no labels; only '540, 540E' was kept.
4035 page copy still calls it 'the largest tractor in the Bad Boy stable' with 35hp, which conflicts with the 5045/5055; this claim was not used.
3026, 1025 and 1022 hydraulic flow rows show two figures separated by '/' (e.g. '7.4 (3.1+4.3) / 28.1 (11.7+16.4)') with no explanation of the second figure; recorded as listed.
4025 overall height is stated as 104.06", which is taller than the 4035H (97"); recorded as stated but worth confirming.

Bandit regular-cab page uses a single spec table for both Bandit 550 and 750, differing only in displacement (545cc vs 735cc); other specs were applied to both. Person capacity is blank on both Bandit pages; Crew Cab seating (4, two rows) comes from the page copy ('first 4-seat UTV'). Top speed is not stated.

The regular-cab page says the Bandit 750 'comes standard with a front bumper and winch', while its feature list and spec table show the winch included for the Bandit in general; the winch was listed for both 550 and 750. Confirm for the 550.
Recon feature bullets say '824 lb Operating Capacity' while its spec table says 748 lbs (824 lbs with optional counterweight); the spec table value was used.
Terrain height is listed as '72.4"/75.4" (with/without Beacon)', which looks reversed; recorded as stated.
E-Series String Trimmer, Chainsaw and Pole Saw pages list a battery with '(288Wh)' that does not match the Max Wh row (160/320/160); both are recorded as stated.
Gas handheld blower spec table labels 450 cfm as 'Air Velocity'; it was recorded as Air Volume 450 CFM.

Implements: one entry per implement type on /tractors/implements (14 types); only summary-level specs (available sizes, warranties, select ratings) were included. The page lists more detailed per-size specs.
Light construction: Recon and Terrain pages do not state a warranty. E-Magnum and both push mowers do not state a warranty except the E-Series self-propelled mower (4 years).
Prices and payment estimates appear on every page and were intentionally excluded.
